How AEW World Championship connects

  • Character: Chris Jericho — Chris Jericho was the first AEW World Champion.
  • Character: Jon Moxley — Jon Moxley is a multi-time AEW World Champion.
  • Character: Kenny Omega — Kenny Omega held the AEW World Championship at AEW's first peak.
  • Character: Hangman Adam Page — Hangman Page won the world title after leaving The Elite.
  • Character: Maxwell Jacob Friedman — MJF's world-title reign was a long heel-ace chapter.
  • Character: Bryan Danielson — Danielson won the AEW World Championship at All In.
  • Character: Swerve Strickland — Swerve Strickland later won the AEW World Championship.

What is AEW World Championship?

The AEW World Championship is the promotion's world title, first won by Chris Jericho at All Out 2019, then carried by Moxley, Omega, Hangman Page, MJF, Danielson, and later champions.

Key threads lead to Chris Jericho, Jon Moxley, Kenny Omega, Hangman Adam Page, Maxwell Jacob Friedman and Bryan Danielson.
